title: Material Gallery
description: A gallery hall of eleven bays where every surface is a material graph: measured metals, scanned texture sets, parallax depth, procedural marble and lava, holograms and force fields, plants and water moved in the material, terrain layered by slope and height, ground, walls and grass steered by the colours painted on their vertices, decals and post-process materials, and a training dummy to cut up in a bay of blood and gore. Open any material in the Material Graph window to see how it is built.
